0.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_000
0.description: Gods, I've been dry as a bone for the past six bells. M-Mead... Jus' give me enough mead to wet me lips...

1.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_SYSTEM_000_001
1.description: The forging and enhancement of relic weapons can only be completed with the following jobs: Paladin, warrior, monk, dragoon, bard, ninja, black mage, summoner, white mage, or scholar.

2.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_001
2.description: <sigh> You again. What in the seven hells do ye want this time?  Whatever it is, I doubt there's coin or drink in it for me.

8.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_010
8.description: Bah, it's just you... Ye'd better bloody well be takin' care o' the relic─gods know she's too good fer the likes o' ye!

9.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_020
9.description: What in the seven hells do ye want now!? I fix ye up with nigh a dozen relics, an' what do I get for all me troubles? <hex:021A020203>Nothin'<hex:021A020103>! Not even a half<hex:021F0103>empty bottle o' mead! Thal take yer black heart! <sob>

10.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_030
10.description: Ye keepin' that Jalzahn bloke busy? Good! Me head's poundin' somethin' fierce right now, an' it's all I can do to keep poundin' kettles!

11.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_040
11.description: ...Atma? Don't know what the hells that is, but if it ain't worth a tankard o' mead, I don't give two shites!

12.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_050
12.description: ...Eh? Stickin' materia all over the relic I painstakin'ly fixed!? Bah, it's yer bloody toy─ye can do whatever the hells ye want with it. Just don't come cryin' to me if it disintegrates in yer hands!

13.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_060
13.description: Jalzahn gave me some o' his soulglaze. Stuff's impressive an' all, but what the hells does he expect <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103> to do with it? Make meself a Zodiac bleedin' <hex:021A020203>kettle<hex:021A020103>?

14.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_065
14.description: 'Tis the real thing, the smithin' what they used to make the arms o' legend. Hells, it's got me thinkin' o' branchin' out from kettles, if ye can believe it!

15.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_070
15.description: This business with the Zodiac Weapons has got me fired up an' rarin' to smith again! An' between you, me, an' the kettle, I owe me thanks to Jalzahn fer that.

16.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_075
16.description: Can ye believe the stubbornness o' that Jalzahn!? I've worked me arse off over the anvil fer years on end to become Eorzea's greatest bleedin' weaponsmith─the title o' Starforger belongs to me!

17.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_078
17.description: I decided to come back an' hammer out a few kettles while His Highness is stickin' his nose in all them books back in Azys Lla. But don't you worry none, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>. When it's time to work, and, gods willin', pay off me debts to Rowena, you can bet me hammer'll be ready.

18.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_079
18.description: I take it yer makin' nice with the anima now that it can finally speak plain? Yer welcome for that, by the way. I swear, if yer wastin' my time with this, you'll have to find yerself a new blacksmith for these crazy schemes o' yers.

19.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_090
19.description: You have any idea how bloody hard it is to buy a drink with Rowena's shadow hangin' over me? Every minute yer pissin' away on that weapon I could be workin' to pay back me debts instead o' followin' his lordship Ardashir around Azys Lla.

20.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_091
20.description: What I wouldn't give fer a day without that pompous little prick sendin' missives to order me about. “Yes, m'lord. Right away, m'lord. Oh, let me fetch that book for ye, m'lord.” What a load o' bollocks!

21.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_092
21.description: Once the weapon's finished, he can take all them soddin' royal decrees and shove 'em up his arse. More importantly, me debts'll be paid! Let me tell ye, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, there ain't nothin' sweeter than the taste of a tall mug bought with a clean conscience─and tab.

22.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_101
22.description: Can ye' believe that snotty little shite? After all I did for him, he up an' ratted me out to Rowena. How's a man to live without his drink? I'd have already forgotten the taste o' mead if Blamprest hadn't shown up. Bless his heart.

23.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_102
23.description: If it weren't for this debt I'd put me boot so far up his... <sigh> Just one more weapon, Gerolt. One more an' it'll all be over...

24.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_110
24.description: “Help him with the anima weapon an' yer debts'll be paid,” she says. Bollocks! This was her godsdamned commission. Why do I have to pay for all them trips back to solid earth? A man needs supplies, don't he? <sigh> Well, back to work I guess.

25.name: TEXT_REGFSTARMORCRAFTSMANLEGENDARY_00159_GEROLT_000_080
25.description: I'd rather not speak o' that one...or that pompous arse of an alchemist, or all the gil he cost me! Gah! I swear, if he's still bleatin' about that damned title o' his, I'll take that bloody kettle and... <mumble> <mumble>
